question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

He _______ a bag of something into the boat, and then got in himself and sat down.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"flung"** means to throw something forcefully or with a quick motion. (फेंक दिया)

 
 
• **Example: **She **flung** the door open and stormed out of the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'flung'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flings** (फेंकता है): The present tense form of fling, meaning to throw something forcefully.

 
 
• **Example:** He flings the ball with all his might.
 
 
 
• **Throw** (फेंकना): The base form of the verb, meaning to propel something with force through the air.
 
 
• **Example:** I can throw the ball very far.
 
 
 
• **Throwed** (ग़लत शब्द): An incorrect form of the past tense of throw.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He throwed a stone. Correct: He threw a stone.
